Hello! My name is Klervin Miel Penalosa, a 19-year-old Junior Full Stack Web Developer with a passion for building modern, user-friendly, and efficient web applications. I enjoy turning ideas into functional digital solutions by combining both front-end and back-end development skills.

As an aspiring developer, I am committed to continuously improving my knowledge of web technologies, learning new frameworks, and staying updated with industry trends. I enjoy solving problems, creating seamless user experiences, and developing applications that deliver real value. I have one ongoing project.
